formula_evaluations.warning: Different step units; these integers are not runtime observations, tight lower bounds, or a speed ratio

actual_tool_findings: random_reference defaults connectivityTrue, copiesG,selects degree-weighted source vertices then uniform neighbors. Each outer round retries to success or a counted failure limit; same-source/shared-vertex continues do not consume that count. niter is multiplied by edge count,not F131 raw4vertex proposal steps.
Turning connectivityFalse removes one filter but does not change proposal normalization,early repeats or success-based outer-loop stopping; no automatic transfer.

double_edge_swap mutatesG,stops at nswap successful swaps,can raise at max_tries; same-source/shared-target continues do not increment its counted-try variable. A half-hold appears only as a code comment,not an executed source-kernel step.

connected_double_edge_swap requires connected initialG,uses adaptive window connectivity checks and rollback,returns successful swaps after counted attempts. Different restricted process,not the configured F131 fixed-step chain.

sigma calls random_reference with default connectivityTrue and computes transitivity and average shortest path lengths. omega likewise relies on random/lattice references and path lengths. The selected shortest-path routine rejects disconnected undirected inputs.

A valid switch on actual15nodeinput removes Acciaiuoli-Medici and Guadagni-Lamberteschi,adds Acciaiuoli-Lamberteschi and Medici-Guadagni. All labelled degrees retained;two components result. Thus F131fullspaceincludesstatesexcludedbyconnected target.

For n15,the general2n8 quarter-TV upper bound is5125781250sourceproposalsteps. This is an upperbound formula,not a lower bound or measuredruntime. NetworkXsigma default2000outerrounds use a different unit,so their ratio is not a speed comparison.
old_methods_suffice_null: Existing connected randomization and small-world metrics already implement a usable computational objective; new all-degree mixing theorem has not been shown to certify or accelerate that different process. Old P-stable/degree-conditioned results and existing Curveball remain separate comparators,not replaced by a weak factor or API label.
